visit.linePrev: Missin' ma', hope that she don't miss the call
visit.lineNext: Like the hard-headed never listen, Lord

visit.line: Tell them all you'd come to visit
stanza: For a moment, you were here
A moment passed and you were gone
Leavin’ me to clean the mess
That you clearly helped to cause
When the boys ask how I slept
I'll just look 'em in the eye
Tell them all you'd come to visit
I didn’t get a wink of sleep all night
